blocks.orig: Explore Jozani Forest with a park ranger, and discover more about the medicinal properties of various plants, and the animals, birds, and reptiles that live in this tropical rainforest in the middle of Zanzibar. During the walk, you encounter troops of Zanzibars Red Colobus monkeys scrambling from branch to branch, in search of food. The monkeys have even become accustomed to people and allow you to get close to them to take photographs as they eat, play, and jump from the treetops!
blocks.html: Walk through Jozani Forest with a park ranger and learn about the healing properties of different plants, as well as the animals, birds and reptiles found in this tropical rainforest in the heart of Zanzibar. On the way you meet troops of Zanzibars Red Colobus monkeys clambering from branch to branch as they look for food. They are so used to people that you can come close and photograph them while they eat, play and leap from the treetops!
